title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in HTMega HT Mega…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in HTMega HT Mega for Elementor versions up to 3.2.8. The flaw is due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which can lead to script injection. This vulnerability has a CVSS score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity impact.
